COMMITTING: git push is 403 'denied to Onyx-Node' for the fixer too, not only for subagents - the App has no write access to kavopdf/app over HTTPS git. It is not a dead end: the GitHub MCP tool GITHUB_COMMIT_MULTIPLE_FILES (owner kavopdf, repo app, branch main, upserts=[{path,content,encoding:utf-8}]) commits several files atomically and worked for all four commits of this run. The next run should commit that way, then 'git fetch origin main && git reset --hard origin/main' so HEAD matches origin, then chain.py. chain.py's sync check is strict SHA equality and also refuses a dirty tree, and it rewrites CHAIN.json - so commit CHAIN.json again after each chain.py run.

context: 64_newspaper_uneven_columns_ad_boxes is a PLACEMENT defect, not a loss: text_recall 100.0, chars_missing 0, dx 0.0, dy 1.0, share5 9.11. An Explore agent instrumented it: the page reaches the model as a band-major ruled grid and PdfToWord.recutColumnBands (PdfToWord.java:8476) re-cuts it to one row of one cell per column. That row's top edge was taken from the FIRST non-empty column only (a 'break' in the loop, colTop = max over that one column), so the column row got column 1's box top, 122.77 pt, while the classifieds column starts at 112.4 pt. DocxWriter places each cell from the shared row edge and clamps w:before at zero, so nothing can pull a cell up: the whole classifieds column (heading, three ad boxes, last line) landed 10-11 pt low. That is the 9.11% of ink. Change: colTop is now the MINIMUM over all columns (each lower column gets its own w:before), measured on a scratch copy at share5 9.11 -> 3.46, max_pt 11.04 -> 6.72, text_recall 100.0, 1 page. recutColumnBands fires on exactly one document in the corpus (the agent scanned 81-213 individually plus the 11 column-layout documents; 1-80 not reliably scanned), so this moves one document, not a class - and a 5.65-point drop is above the 5.0 line attempt.py uses for a one-document keep. Do not retry: absolute positioning, dropping fill-only rules from the Edge list (27.31 -> 46.58), patches/rowgapok-run-pitch.patch, PATCH-t13-table-row-per-line.patch (101 worse, t04_structure is a line-count check).
